about: Modwerk source-only live-looper package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/live-looper.

mods.title: Live Looper
mods.summary: A looper machine for one audio track: it records the master mix or the inputs all the time, catches the loop playing now at a button press, and keeps it playing through pattern changes.
